requestKey: Daily stretches for people who sit all day|sway.day|sample1

payload.text:
Here’s a simple, effective daily plan to undo a day of sitting. It combines quick “microbreaks” with two short stretch blocks. No equipment needed.

How often
- Microbreak: 1–2 minutes every 30–45 minutes.
- Midday “Desk Reset”: 8–12 minutes.
- After-work “Undo the Chair”: 10–15 minutes.

Microbreak menu (pick 3–5 each break)
- Chin tucks: 10 slow reps, 3-second hold.
- Scap squeezes: 12 reps, elbows by sides, squeeze shoulder blades down/back.
- Thoracic extension over chair back: 8–10 reps, hands support head.
- Doorway pec opener: 30–45 seconds.
- Standing hip swings front-to-back and side-to-side: 10 each.
- Calf raises: 15–20 reps.
- Wrist circles + palm/finger stretches: 30 seconds each direction.
- Walk to get water, one flight of stairs, or 60 seconds of gentle marching.
- Eyes: 20-20-20 rule (every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds).

Midday “Desk Reset” (8–12 minutes)
- Neck
  - Upper trap stretch: ear to shoulder, 30–45 seconds/side.
  - Levator scap stretch: nose to armpit, 30–45 seconds/side.
- Chest/upper back
  - Doorway pec stretch (elbow at shoulder height): 45–60 seconds/side.
  - Seated or standing “T-spine open book” rotations: 8 reps/side.
- Shoulders
  - Wall angels or snow angels on wall: 8–12 slow reps.
- Wrists/forearms
  - Wrist flexor and extensor stretches: 30 seconds each/side.
- Hips/legs
  - Standing hip flexor lunge stretch: 45–60 seconds/side.
  - Hamstring stretch (heel on low step or straight-leg hinge): 45 seconds/side.
  - Figure-4 glute stretch (seated or standing): 45 seconds/side.
- Calves/ankles
  - Wall calf stretch (knee straight, then bent): 30 seconds each/side.

After-work “Undo the Chair” (10–15 minutes)
- Spine and ribs
  - Cat–cow: 8–10 slow reps.
  - Child’s pose with side reach: 30–45 seconds/side.
  - Thread-the-needle: 30–45 seconds/side.
- Hips
  - Couch or kneeling hip flexor stretch: 2 x 45–60 seconds/side.
  - 90/90 hip rotations: 6–10 reps/side.
  - Pigeon or supine figure-4: 45–60 seconds/side.
  - Hamstring strap stretch (on back): 45–60 seconds/side.
- Shoulders/lats
  - Overhead lat stretch on doorframe or countertop: 30–45 seconds/side.
  - Behind-the-back towel stretch (internal/external rotation): 30 seconds/side.

Form cues
- Move to mild–moderate stretch; no sharp pain or numbness.
- Breathe: in through nose, out longer through mouth; don’t hold your breath.
- Ease in/out; avoid bouncing. For mobility reps, move slowly through the range.

Ergonomic quick wins
- Chair: hips slightly above knees; back supported; use a small lumbar roll if helpful.
- Feet: flat on floor or footrest; avoid crossing legs for long periods.
- Desk/keyboard: elbows ~90 degrees, shoulders relaxed.
- Monitor: top of screen at or slightly below eye level; arm’s length away.
- Phone: avoid prolonged neck flexion; use earbuds or speaker.

If you have pain that radiates, tingling/numbness, or symptoms that don’t improve after 2–3 weeks, check with a healthcare professional.

Want this turned into a printable one-page checklist or a version tailored to your space/equipment? Tell me your constraints (e.g., tight hips, limited shoulder mobility, only have a wall/desk), and I’ll customize it.
